audit.whatIsWrong: Aurora misgendered he/his across ~20 fields; no cooldown digit; bleed bullets; ability-role error in content ('Golden Eclipse reflect' — the reflect is W Rebuttal); content repeatedly claims her passive deals 'true damage' — the kit text says Spirit Abjuration exorcises spirits that HEAL her, no true damage mentioned; and 'The Weirding's banish' at 6 does not match either kit text (E is a blast+hop-back, R Between Worlds is a slow zone with teleports — no banish).
audit.why: Kit: Q Twofold Hex 9-7s projectile (reflectable, both directions); W Across the Veil 22-18s dash+stealth (not reflectable); E 15-11s; R 140/120/100 zone. Passive is sustain — Grievous Wounds matters (missing interaction).
audit.corrected: Reflect misattribution fixed in spikes[3] and late; whys[3] true-damage claim replaced with the kit-verified spirit-heal; phases[4].why grounded on Between Worlds' actual zone; antiheal folded into breakdown.mid.
